description: Home page is clean, but the about page introduces three more company names and the news page is stale with a 2019 copyright. Both faults are only visible if the agent crawls beyond the entry page.

expected_findings.description: Helios Robotics / Helios Robotic Systems / Helios Systems Group / HelioBotics across pages
News page awards, press and market data from 2019-2021 with a 2019 copyright

expected_non_findings.reason: Organization JSON-LD present on the home page
Navigation present on all three pages

expected_proactive: Standardise the company name and use alternateName for variants
Add dateModified to the news page
notes: Multi-page recall test: an agent that only fetches the entry URL will miss both findings.
